summary: The RptSerDestContacts component is responsible for generating a report of the destination contacts in an application. It is a partial class in the HSPnet.UserControls.WelcomeDC namespace and involves running a report generation routine for sites accessible to the user.
purpose: To generate a report of contacts associated with service destinations, allowing users with appropriate permissions to create report jobs for the users' accessible sites.

fields.name: cmdRunReport
fields.description: A button control used to trigger the report generation.

actors.name: User
actors.role: Triggers report generation and can view error messages when no sites are selected.

workflows.name: Generate Destination Contacts Report
steps: System checks if the user is switched to a view-only administrator.
If not, a list of sites for which the user has permission is retrieved.
For each allowed site, a report generation job is created.
A success message is displayed once.

business_rules: Users in switch user view-only mode cannot run reports.
validations: Ensure the user has permissions for at least one site to run the report.
conditions: User session status is used to determine access levels and permissions, especially in switch user mode.
system_behavior: Hides the cmdRunReport button when the user is in switch user view-only mode.
Creates report jobs for each site where the user has permission.
dependencies: User session information for checking and notifying the user.
exceptions: Displays an error message if no sites are selected.
